description: Find open-source GitHub repos on gitmanual's shelf: by words in the name or description, by the system they run on, language or difficulty, or only those rising on GitHub this week. Each result links to its setup manual.

language.description: Main language, as GitHub names it, e.g. "Python".

os.description: Only repos that run on this system.

query.description: Words to look for in the repo's name or description.

rising.description: Only repos rising on GitHub this week.

sort.description: stars (default), recent, popular, or worked (most people got it running).

name: search_repos
title: Search repos with setup manuals
